title: War in Ukraine: Four young Ukrainians tell us how they see their future
summary: Their names are Oleksandr, Sofiia, Bohdan and Angelina. Aged between 18 and 28, these young Ukrainians are living in a country still at war.As Tuesday marks the fourth year of Russia’s large-scale invasion in Ukraine, France 24 gives them the floor, to know more about their hopes, their fears and their dreams for the future.
